title: AI-Trader: Can AI Beat the Market?  #github #gitHubtrending

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Five AIs, one battlefield. NASDAQ 100 AI trader sets up a fully autonomous trading arena where GPT, Claude, Quen, and more compete head-to-head. Zero human input, pure AI strategy. Each agent starts with $10,000 and trades NASDAQ stocks using real market data, automated research, and tool-driven execution. They analyze markets, pull financial intel, place trades, and log strategy decisions, all through the model context protocol without a single manual command. Historical replays, real-time analytics, profit tracking, and strategy evolution make this a full AI trading lab, not a toy.
